This website

This static site adds no analytics, advertising scripts, contact forms, or tracking cookies. Its hosting provider may process connection data to deliver the site and control access to this private preview. Links to other sites are governed by those sites' policies.

The direct macOS app

Account profiles, session metadata, and backups are stored locally on your Mac. Profiles contain sensitive login state. The switcher does not send that state to Synesthetic Systems.

Optional live usage checks read the saved account's Claude login cookie and send authenticated requests only to claude.ai. These cookies are full login credentials. Decrypted credentials are kept in memory, not written to a separate credential store or logged. The app saves usage percentages, reset dates, and sanitized status locally.

macOS may request access to Claude Safe Storage in your Keychain. The app explains this before interactive approval. Background checks do not prompt. You can turn Live Usage off in the app.

Before public release

The release policy will identify the final product, support contact, distribution details, and data removal procedure. This page documents the current development build; it is not a claim of App Store approval or an offer of a publicly available download.
